active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; no strong rolling mean subtraction in first implementation
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 674a is the strongest recent IV-only clean-family candidate but remains 6/11. Remaining failures are narrow and localized: median bias 16/25, conditional worst-cell width near 1.49, regime layer-2 coverage, and mean-reversion active-cell count 8/12 while aggregate/full-horizon profile mostly passes.
last_result_summary: 674a trained the all-window channel-balanced objective for 3 epochs and selected epoch 2 with val_total 1.755. IV-only evaluation reached 6/11 with coverage90 0.829, calibration error 0.051, level KS 15/25 passed, persistent undercoverage 3.7% passed, pathwise KS 0.451 passed, median-bias 16/25 failed, and mean reversion failed narrowly because active first-step cells were 8/12.
next_step_recommendation: Before another model change, run a higher-sample evaluation of the same 674a checkpoint to separate true failures from Monte Carlo noise, especially mean reversion, coverage, and pathwise KS.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general IV/anchor/joint state-aware normalized-innovation family, 666a remains the best joint-audited checkpoint, while 674a is the strongest recent IV-only candidate by submetrics: coverage90 0.829, level KS passed, persistent undercoverage passed, and pathwise realism passed. For native IV+anchor joint generation, a joint audit is still required before promoting 674a-style training as the general baseline.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
